nodes.name: SW1
nodes.startup_config:
hostname SW1
spanning-tree mode rstp
spanning-tree priority 4096
vlan 1,100,200
lldp run
management vlan 1
snmp-server source 0.0.0.0/0
interface eth0
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport access vlan 1
 switchport trunk native vlan 1
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 100,200
 spanning-tree cost 0
 lldp transmit
 lldp receive
 no spanning-tree portfast
 no spanning-tree bpduguard
 no shutdown
exit
interface eth1
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport access vlan 1
 switchport trunk native vlan 1
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 100,200
 spanning-tree cost 0
 lldp transmit
 lldp receive
 no spanning-tree portfast
 no spanning-tree bpduguard
 no shutdown
exit
interface eth2
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport access vlan 100
 switchport trunk native vlan 1
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 100,200
 spanning-tree cost 0
 lldp transmit
 lldp receive
 spanning-tree portfast
 no spanning-tree bpduguard
 no shutdown
exit

nodes.name: R1
nodes.startup_config:
lldp run
snmp-server community labMonitor ro
snmp-server listen 10.255.0.1
snmp-server source 0.0.0.0/0
snmp-server contact Lab Operations
snmp-server location Rack A
snmp-server enable
vlan interface eth0.100
vlan interface eth0.200
frr version 10.7.1_weblab_lldp_snmp_vlan_vrrp1
frr defaults traditional
hostname R1
service integrated-vtysh-config
!
interface eth0
 description Trunk to SW1
exit
!
interface eth0.100
 description OSPF transit through LL2S VLAN 100
 ip address 10.0.30.1/24 label secondary
 ip address 10.100.0.1/24
 ip ospf area 0
 ip ospf dead-interval 4
 ip ospf hello-interval 1
 ip ospf priority 100
 no ip ospf passive
exit
!
interface eth0.200
 ip address 10.0.20.2/24
 ip ospf area 0
 ip ospf passive
 vrrp 20 version 3
 vrrp 20 priority 200
 vrrp 20 ip 10.0.20.1
exit
!
interface eth1
 description PC1
 ip address 10.0.1.1/24
 ip ospf area 0
 ip ospf passive
exit
!
interface lo
 ip address 10.255.0.1/32
 ip ospf area 0
 ip ospf passive
exit
!
router ospf
 ospf router-id 10.255.0.1
 passive-interface default
exit
!
